Author: @hyenascreech2183
Content: I am tired of hearing it so I will tell you the oxygen water science. Oxygen is lighter than water and it gets pushed to the top. Water carries oxygen within it but over time it leaves the water without flow/movement. Without oxygenating the water, you wont have any oxygen to contribute to the aging process that you love. The water also acts as a filter to let nothing in but oxygen and everything else out but liquids (which keeps it juicy), so bad stuff in the air doesn't make contact with it, just the oxygen. Anyway, there's your science answer. You'd be just as successful giving the water a good stir/shake for a few seconds to oxygenate it as you would with those little bubblers.
